draftBefore.emotion: tender and protective, speaking of someone you cherish
notes: When talking about your own daughter, you usually say 'musume'. When talking about someone else's daughter, it is polite to add '-san' (musume-san).
Be careful not to confuse this with 'onna' (woman), which refers to gender rather than a family relationship.
